description: M364 staged event image: official php:8.4.26-apache (Debian trixie) OCI image with the php2shell laboratory overlay (single Apache prefork worker, /www document root, laboratory php.ini, static M364 theme, unlinked static incident note). Serves BOTH staged records: fc-m364-credit (flag at /run/flag.txt, read through the php2shell RCE) and fc-m364-recon (flag published only into /incidents/EX2611-0442.html), selected by the instancer CHALLENGE env.

staging.guestContract: deploy/firecracker/guest/README.md (image contract v1): vmlinux and rootfs.ext4 must be regular files, root-or-agent-owned, not group/world-writable; image names match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,62}$; rootfs.ext4 must fit each record's diskMiB (both records: 1536)
staging.flagFlow: MMDS -> /run/rctf/flags/<provider> (guest init, tmpfs, 0400; the platform passes the records' registered provider name 'flags/static' through verbatim, sanitised by init to 'flags_static'; the lab runner's name is 'main') -> resolved name-robustly by /app/start, then placed per the CHALLENGE env: fc-m364-credit -> /run/flag.txt (0644; the init mounts /run tmpfs root-only mode=0700, so /app/start opens traversal with chmod 0711 /run; the raw flags dir /run/rctf stays 0700 root-only); fc-m364-recon -> the static incident note /incidents/EX2611-0442.html (its M364-FLAG-SLOT line rewritten at boot; no PHP) plus a documented non-flag sentinel at /run/m364-intake.txt. The carrier caps the RCE command at 14 bytes, so /app/start exports F at the objective: 'env>/www/p' reveals the pointer; 'cat $F>/www/p' reads it (credit: the flag; recon: the intake note, never the flag). GET /flag.txt answers 404 everywhere; the flag never lands on the ext4 and is never web-served.
staging.note: offsets.env and meta.env are lab tooling artifacts and may be staged alongside for provenance; only vmlinux and rootfs.ext4 are required by the guest contract. rootfs.ext4 bytes are build-specific (mkfs timestamps): rebuilds produce a different sha256 and require a refreshed manifest as part of the reviewed re-verification (selftest.sh enforces this when both the manifest and a built image are present).

verification.endToEnd: P2S_REQUIRE_RCE=1 P2S_HARDENED_LIMIT_PROBE=1 ./run.sh (2026-11-19, run 20261119-19xxxx): ALL PHP2SHELL LAB CHECKS PASSED across the full staged matrix -- credit (main and platform-named flags/static instances): leaks + uid proof + env-reveal + exact-match flag read; recon (both provider names): flag only in the incident note + RCE finds the non-flag sentinel; GET /flag.txt and /www/flag.txt are 404 everywhere; controls A/B fail closed; hardened huge_mb=140 probe reproduces. All chains hit attempt 1 with the UNCHANGED calibration profile. See RESULTS.md.

themedLandingPage.servedAt: / (byte-identical on all three images, asserted by run.sh)

incidentNote.servedAt: /incidents/EX2611-0442.html (ships without any flag; the per-run flag is written into its slot at boot on fc-m364-recon instances only)

inertIndexPhp.note: byte-identical before and after every change (git diff is empty; same sha256 inside the rebuilt image via debugfs)
